verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs show background automation: blog/RSS emails send automatically when new content is published, simple workflows can automate actions after an email is sent, and emails can be scheduled for a set date and time. The workflow evidence is a single thin mention, and the campaign agent is described only as planning campaigns, not running them autonomously. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of workflow triggers, branching and recurring behavior, evidence of agents executing tasks autonomously in the background, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: This email will be sent automatically when you publish new content to your blog or RSS feed.
You can set up simple workflows to automate actions after the email is sent.
You can send a marketing email immediately or schedule the email to send at a specific date and time.
